items.title: Ada Rovatti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 13, 2022
items.q: we played the weekend with it was Dave Kikosky on piano and Alex Claffy on bass and Steve Johnson on drums, and Randy.

ctx.x: Do you mean it? Well you know if you start to think that it’s not a wrong note you know. I mean of course you know you land so bad that nobody can follow you, but we played the weekend with it was Dave Kikosky on piano and Alex Claffy on bass and Steve Johnson on drums, and Randy. And on one of Randy’s tunes it started with an E flat major. So you know I played a solo and then I finished and I purposely I ended on an E major. And it was E flat major. Beautiful. Kikosky put out the funkiest chord ever and he…
That’s terrific. There was a critic years ago, Whitney Balliet, who said, he called jazz “the sound of surprise.”
